sample_title: P. brasilianum SFC20200506-M13 co-cultured with Bacillus subtilis DK1042 wild type (replicate 1)
isolation_source: co-culture with Bacillus subtilis DK1042 wild type on potato dextrose agar
description: Fungal RNA-seq sample. Penicillium brasilianum SFC20200506-M13 was co-cultured with Bacillus subtilis DK1042 (the naturally competent comI-Q12L derivative of NCIB 3610), which produces bacillibactin. Biological replicate 1 of 3. The bacterial partner is the only difference between the two experimental groups. Total RNA was extracted from the co-culture, so the library also contains bacterial transcripts; reads were mapped to the P. brasilianum MG11 reference genome (GCA_001048715.1). Medium: potato dextrose agar (PDA). Temperature: TODO. Incubation time before harvest: TODO.
